# Pregret

> Know Before You Regret. Pregret shows the crowdsourced Regret Score (0–100) for any consumer product, built from real owner satisfaction data at day 30, 60, and 90 — not honeymoon reviews from launch week. Free for shoppers across the United States and Canada.

## Product

Pregret tracks a Regret Score (0 = nobody regrets, 100 = everyone regrets) for consumer products across Electronics, Kitchen, Fitness, and Personal Care. Scores are computed from user check-ins at three time points (day 30, 60, 90) with day-90 weighted 3x. When a product has a high Regret Score, Pregret recommends alternatives with lower regret — those are the affiliate links that fund the service.

## Coverage

United States and Canada. Amazon.com and Amazon.ca affiliate integration. All content is English.

## Key routes

- `/` — homepage
- `/product/{slug}` — individual product page with Regret Score, decay curve, alternatives
- `/category/{slug}` — category browse (electronics, kitchen, fitness, personal-care)
- `/search?q=` — product search
- `/blog` — long-form articles
- `/about` — mission and methodology
- `/api/extension/lookup?title=&brand=&asin=` — public JSON endpoint for browser extension integrations

## How the score is computed

For each product:
- `regret_score = weighted_regret_responses / weighted_total_responses × 100`
- day 30 responses weight 1x, day 60 weight 2x, day 90 weight 3x
- a response is "regret" if satisfaction ≤ 2 on a 5-point scale
